fields.notes: DDR5's protocol-level DFT surface is the mode registers (MRR/MRW), MPC-driven training feedback, on-die-ECC / ECS reporting, ALERT_n for write-CRC and CA-parity, and ZQ calibration. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain DRAM-vendor concerns; conformance is established by JEDEC compliance testing.

exposed_dft_features.purpose: Wrapper-based test access through the base/logic die for boundary and interconnect (TSV/microbump) test.
Direct probing of the DRAM dies through the base die for KGSD screening.
Memory built-in self-test of the DRAM array per channel.
Characterize the high-speed links at up to 6.4 Gb/s/pin.
Fuse-based hard repair at manufacturing and runtime soft-repair for RAS.
Observe corrected/uncorrectable error counts (on-die ECC, link ECC, CA parity).

fields.test_in_base_die: HBM3 concentrates test, repair, and RAS logic in the base/logic die so the DRAM dies remain dense; the base die exposes IEEE-1500 / DA ports to the interposer. TSMC produces the base die for HBM and is planned as a foundry for HBM stacking.
fields.stacked_die_dft_flow: Per-die screen -> stack assembly -> KGSD test through the base die -> stack-on-interposer interconnect test -> in-field RAS monitoring (ECC/parity counters, soft-repair).

in_band_test_facilities.name: Mode Register Read (MRR)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Read status, on-die-ECC error counts, and ECS results.

in_band_test_facilities.name: MPC training/feature modes
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Exercise DFE, Vref, ZQ, and read/write training and read back results.

in_band_test_facilities.name: On-die-ECC / ECS reporting
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Single-bit error and scrub observability via mode registers.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Per-sub-channel training results (DFE taps, VrefDQ/VrefCA centers, read/write deskew).
On-die-ECC single-bit error counts and ECS status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: Module-level SPD-hub / PMIC / RCD bring-up over the sideband bus.
